response.sql: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_byte_rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_byte_rate) AS cross_media_rate FROM media_averages) SELECT AVG(m.avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.avg_byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(m.avg_byte_rate - o.cross_media_rate) AS avg_rate_excess FROM media_averages AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.avg_byte_rate > o.cross_media_rate;

assumptions.assumption: Track durations are nonzero, so bytes divided by milliseconds is defined.
